description:
Audit the dividend records for Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) in the provided portfolio against the brokerage statement CSV. 

1. Open the portfolio file `/home/ga/Documents/PortfolioData/dividend_audit.xml` in Portfolio Performance.
2. Open the brokerage statement `/home/ga/Documents/broker_statement_2023.csv` to view the official record of payments.
3. Compare the records and identify which 2023 dividend payments are missing from Portfolio Performance.
4. Manually record the missing dividend transactions in Portfolio Performance using the exact Date, Gross Amount, and Taxes shown in the CSV.
5. Save the portfolio file.
